title: Implement deterministic evidence compression and expansion

implementation.ingress_redaction: Known secret values and deterministic generic credential shapes are redacted before CAS persistence; persisted evidence records redaction events.
implementation.raw_spool_bounds: Per-action and remaining per-task raw byte quotas bound retained post-redaction bytes. Truncation records raw_complete=false, retained ranges/counts and an explicit reason, including the zero-remaining-task-quota case.
implementation.synopses: Compiler, test, search, log, diff and JSON evidence produce deterministic bounded model-facing synopses with version/digests and stable failure signatures.
implementation.expansion: Expansion reads retained CAS bytes by digest/range without rerunning the tool and returns explicit not_retained evidence for truncated ranges.
implementation.recompression: Historical retained raw evidence can be recompressed into a new synopsis version without rewriting the immutable raw artifact.

completion_evidence.compression_fixture: 10,000-line log bounded by configured synopsis budget
